name: aigc-provider-runtime-kit-workspace
description: Monorepo: reusable AIGC provider runtime SDK plus the provider/RunningHub control-center backend.

scripts.build: npm run build -w aigc-provider-runtime-kit && npm run build -w @aigc-kit/control-center
scripts.type-check: npm run build -w aigc-provider-runtime-kit && npm run type-check -w aigc-provider-runtime-kit && npm run type-check -w @aigc-kit/control-center
scripts.test: npm run build -w aigc-provider-runtime-kit && node --test packages/kit/tests/*.test.mjs && npm run build -w @aigc-kit/control-center && node --test packages/control-center/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:package: npm run build -w aigc-provider-runtime-kit && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
scripts.harness:verify:release: npm run verify:harness && npm run type-check && npm test && npm run test:package
